title: Action project file
description: Settings for checking Action sources in the editor. Paths are relative to this file.

module.description: The module: its name starts the import path of each package, followed by the package's folder inside this file's folder.

name.description: The module's name, such as github.com/you/project.

requires.description: The modules this module uses, by module path (such as github.com/you/lib). Fetch them with 'action --fetch' (in Particle: make deps); fetching needs git.

version.description: The lowest version needed: a git tag such as v1.2.0 (or v1.2.0-beta.1).

git.description: The repository to fetch from, when it is not https:// followed by the module path.

path.description: A folder to use instead of a fetched version (only in the main module's action.json). Its action.json must name the same module.

includeDirs.description: Directories searched by 'import', like the compiler's -I. The workspace root and its lib directory are always searched.

defines.description: Constants defined as with the compiler's -D NAME=VALUE.

target.description: The compiler programs are checked for: "particle" (the default) or "llvm", or a list of both. With both, an error found for only one of them is shown as a warning naming it. A file with a build directive such as '//act:build llvm' is checked for the targets it is built for.

programFolders.description: Folders whose subfolders are each one program: all the .act files in a subfolder are checked together. Adding a folder or a file needs no change here.

programs.description: Groups of files compiled together (as on the compiler's command line). A file listed here is checked with the rest of its group; any other file is checked on its own, with its imports.
